note: FAIL example — teaches the E1 (banned opener) hard-block. Opens with 'I hope this email finds you well' and stacks 'In today's AI landscape' — both are on the banned-openers list in every real copy-evaluator rubric this pattern has been used with. The evaluator must FAIL this draft even though the body is otherwise fine.
subject: Reaching out about your AI journey
body:
Hi Sam,

I hope this email finds you well. In today's AI landscape, retrieval-layer decisions are more important than ever, and I saw your recent Series B announcement.

<YOUR_COMPANY> works with companies like yours on their retrieval stack. Would love to jump on a quick call to explore how we can help you unlock more value.

Best regards,
<FOUNDER_NAME>
